minor.issue: document_number/reference '³' or '²³' passes .isdigit() but int() raises ValueError -> 500 Internal Server Error. Use .isdecimal() + ASCII check (re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+', v)) or try/except int(). Payments path fails before allocation so no invoice corruption.

insert_one is not wrapped for DuplicateKeyError; if a real race hits the new unique index the user gets 500 instead of the friendly 400 'deja înregistrat'. (Payments path does rollback allocations before re-raising.) Not reproduced with 8 concurrent requests, code-review finding.
Very large numbers (e.g. '0000000009' or 7+ digits) are accepted and formatted without upper bound (e.g. DP-1234567); consider a max of 999999 if 6 digits must be strict.
